results.title: Temperature-controlled shipments get retrospective logs, not live deviation alerts
results.closest_fact_claim: Blue Dart offers Temperature Controlled Logistics as a specialized service across three ranges -- Frozen (-20°C), Chilled (2-8°C), Ambient (15-25°C) -- for pharmaceuticals, clinical research organizations, and hospitals, covering items like blood, plasma, tissues, life-saving drugs, and diagnostics kits across 53 origin-destination pairs.
